summary_oneline: Add a typed OdooHelpdeskToolkit (subclass of OdooToolkit) for the Softhealer sh_all_in_one_helpdesk + TROC layer on Odoo 19: ticket CRUD, assignment, stage transitions via Softhealer action_* methods, comments, SLA policies, reference-data lookups, with Pydantic inputs and result envelopes.

generic search with smart-field fallback and `SearchResult` envelope
base for every tool input schema (`extra="ignore"`)

constraints.statement: All Odoo I/O must go through `OdooToolkit._execute` (transport-agnostic); no direct aiohttp calls in a helpdesk layer.
constraints.implication: helpdesk tools are thin wrappers over `_execute` + Pydantic validation.

constraints.statement: Tools are discovered by reflection over public `async def` methods; `@tool_schema` + docstring define the LLM schema; writes use `@requires_permission("odoo.write")`.
constraints.implication: a subclass auto-registers its methods as `odoo_<name>`; private helpers must be underscore-prefixed.

constraints.statement: Models follow the entities / inputs / envelopes split with `_OdooEntity(extra=allow)`, `_OdooBaseInput(extra=ignore)` and envelope classes.
constraints.implication: helpdesk `HelpdeskTicket`, `*Input`, `*Result` classes go into the same three modules (or siblings re-exported from `models/__init__`).

constraints.statement: On this tenant the ticket lifecycle is `stage_id` over 5 linear stages chained by `sh_next_stage`; `state` means reply direction; stage ids are instance-specific; Softhealer done/cancel button flags are off on every stage.
constraints.implication: transition tools must resolve stages by name / `sh_next_stage`, and the `action_done`/`action_cancel` paths may be no-ops here — writing `stage_id` may be the effective transition.

constraints.statement: JSON-2 cannot map `get_views` and (until FEAT-614) the `read_group` family; `[[id]]` action calls and `search_read/search_count/read/write/create/name_search` work.
constraints.implication: stats tools depend on FEAT-614; view-driven discovery must read `ir.ui.view.arch_db`.
sequence the helpdesk feature after FEAT-614 or keep it in new files only.

constraints.statement: `ODOO_HELPDESK_*` env keys (URL/USER/PASSWORD/APIKEY, no DATABASE) are not read anywhere in the code; `OdooToolkit` only knows `ODOO_*` via `parrot.conf`; JSON-2 works with an empty database.
constraints.implication: the helpdesk toolkit needs either explicit constructor args from the agent or new `ODOO_HELPDESK_*` conf keys; `database` must be allowed empty for JSON-2.

constraints.statement: The staging tenant is TROC-customised (extra_fields bag, dynamic-form origin, reassign wizard, `assignee_on_leave`, webhook dedupe); 0 SLA policies exist.
constraints.implication: SLA-related outputs cannot be validated end-to-end on staging without creating a policy; extra fields need a generic `dict` projection.

constraints.statement: Tests for the Odoo toolkit live in `packages/ai-parrot/tests/` with an AsyncMock transport and assert exact `execute_kw` tuples.
constraints.implication: helpdesk tests follow the same fixture; no network in unit tests.

new: `parrot_tools/odoo/helpdesk.py` — `OdooHelpdeskToolkit(OdooToolkit)` (name TBD, U1) with helpdesk tools grouped as: ticket read (`get_ticket`, `search_tickets`/`list_tickets`, `get_ticket_history`, `get_ticket_messages`, `get_ticket_extra_fields`), ticket write (`create_ticket`, `update_ticket`, `assign_ticket`/`take_ticket`/`reassign_ticket`, `add_ticket_comment`/`reply_ticket`), transitions (`move_ticket_stage`, `resolve_ticket`, `close_ticket`, `cancel_ticket`, `reopen_ticket`, `approve_ticket`), SLA (`list_sla_policies`, `create_sla_policy`, `update_sla_policy`, `get_ticket_sla_status`), reference data (`list_stages`, `list_teams`, `list_categories`, `list_priorities`, `list_ticket_types`, `list_tags`), optional stats (`ticket_stats` — gated on FEAT-614).

Inputs: one `_OdooBaseInput` per tool (`CreateTicketInput`, `SearchTicketsInput`, `MoveTicketStageInput`, `AssignTicketInput`, `AddTicketCommentInput`, `CreateSlaPolicyInput`, …) with stage/team/category accepted by id **or** name.
Tests: `packages/ai-parrot/tests/test_odoo_helpdesk_toolkit.py` (AsyncMock transport) + optional live smoke script under `examples/`.
